title.narrative: Comprehensive Socioeconomic Urban Development Project in Viet Tri, Hung Yen and Dong Dang

description.narrative: The proposed Project will address critical urban development issues of Viet Tri, Hung Yen, and Dong Dang in northern Viet Nam along the North-South economic corridor (NSEC), in contributing to the transformation of the NSEC from transport corridor into full-fledged economic corridor and in complementing Hanoi as alternative growth centers.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 2826: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: Outcome likely to be achieved. All outputs under ADB financing have been achieved by loan closing date of 30 June 2017. One output under KEXIM financing (wastewater treatment plant and associated network) will be achieved by 31 January 2020.
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Dec 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41462/41462-013-rp-11.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jun 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41462-013-smr-08.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: All activities under ADB loan completed by 30 June 2017.
The wastewater treatment plant and associated network under KEXIM loan is ongoing and expected to complete by 31 July 2019.
